note: Triennial election of Down County Council on the 20 county electoral divisions; nominations received by R. J. Dickson, returning officer, at Downpatrick on 7 May 1924. Seventeen divisions were returned unopposed and no one was nominated for Castlewellan or Warrenpoint; the only poll was in Gilford on Thursday 5 June 1924, counted at the County Courthouse, Downpatrick, the next day (Belfast News-Letter, 8 May and 7 June 1924). The nominations list prints no party labels, so none are given. Both were members of the outgoing council: Blane the nominee of the West Down Unionist Association, Getgood an official of the Workers' Union.
